download_scope: Both split payloads are fully acquired at manifest size; full-shard SHA256 values match publisher manifests
validation_command: nix develop --command cargo run -p agentix-qwen-sys --example validate_gguf_sample_rows -- agentix-qwen/tests/fixtures/qwen3_8_flash_next_config.json <full-shard-0> <full-shard-1>

sample_row_validation.scope: one row from one tensor per storage type; a 320x10240 BF16 matrix and actual token ID 1 execute through all 48 configured decoder blocks, including block-1 PLE lookup/projections/convolution over 16 actual hashed rows, every GatedDeltaNet/QSA attention path, each residual mixer, and each routed/shared MoE; final stream combine and vocabulary projection produce finite logits. The reusable decoder runs the existing PreparedPrompt greedy-generation adapter and preserves per-layer recurrent, QSA, n-gram PLE, and position state across token 1 and greedy token 79104, reaching cached_position=2; first-step greedy token is 79104 (logit 11.96474266), and second-step greedy token is 245228. This uses token ID 1 as a minimal prepared prompt, not rendered chat text, and has no independent expected-logit oracle; separate block-0 prefill and long synthetic-past QSA checks remain operator checks; sparse selector retains 2,049 of 4,097 visible tokens under 2,048 budget; invalid expert groups rejected

limits: Sample-row validation is not a full-tensor numeric parity test
Native row readers use pinned GGML CPU type-traits callbacks
No CUDA decoder or independent full-model output parity is established
